items.title: URNet: A Unified Reparameterized Network for Efficient RGB-D Semantic Segmentation
items.abstract: Previous RGB-D semantic segmentation methods commonly employ dual encoders to separately process RGB and depth inputs, followed by dedicated modules for cross-modal feature fusion. However, such designs often inadequately capture depth representations and consequently limit effective cross-modal interaction, while the additional encoder branch introduces redundant computation that hinders lightweight execution. To tackle these challenges, we propose URNet, a Unified Reparameterized RGB-D Network that performs simultaneous multi-modal feature extraction and cross-modal fusion within a single encoder. Specifically, we adopt a reparameterization strategy to compact the network architecture and facilitate fast inference. Within each Reparameterized Block (RepBlock), a Linear Gated Attention (LGA) module is introduced to fully exploit complementary RGB and depth cues across different feature scales. Furthermore, considering that decoder design has been relatively underexplored in existing RGB-D segmentation models, we develop a concise yet effective universal decoder, termed the Pyramid Merging Decoder (PMD). Extensive experiments on multiple RGB-D segmentation benchmarks demonstrate that URNet achieves state-of-the-art performance while maintaining high efficiency. Code will be available at https://github.com/Wild-Stephen/URNet.

items.llm_tldr_en: URNet proposes a unified reparameterized RGB-D network that fuses RGB and depth in a single encoder via reparameterization, enabling efficient simultaneous multi-modal extraction and cross-modal fusion for semantic segmentation.
items.llm_tldr_cn: 现有RGB-D语义分割通常使用双编码器分别处理RGB与深度再融合，但深度表示提取不充分且计算冗余。URNet提出统一重参数化网络，在单编码器内同步完成多模态特征提取与跨模态融合，通过重参数化压缩结构并加速推理。该方法在轻量化执行的同时改善了跨模态交互与分割性能。
